rows.headline: The Exchange has sought clarification from Oriental Aromatics Ltd on October 16, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
rows.subject: Clarification sought from Oriental Aromatics Ltd
rows.title: The Exchange has sought clarification from Oriental Aromatics Ltd on October 16, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
Spurt in Volume
rows.summary: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Oriental Aromatics Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Oriental Aromatics Limited has submitted their response.
